单位: Department of Implantology, Be Dental School, Universidade do Vale do Itajaí (UNIVALI), São José, 88102-700, Brazil
通讯: Márcio de Carvalho Formiga @ Department of Implantology, Be Dental School, Universidade do Vale do Itajaí (UNIVALI), São José, 88102-700, Brazil  |  Gustavo Vicentis Oliveira Fernandes @ Periodontics, Bitonte College of Dentistry, Northeast Ohio Medical University (NEOMED), Rootstown, 44272, OH, USA
相关性: 该文通过合成骨块实验比较三种种植体微几何的初期稳定性，与髋关节股骨柄的初期稳定性/微动研究在力学概念上可迁移，但非髋关节植入物。
边界: This study tests dental implant macrogeometry in synthetic polyurethane blocks and does not model the proximal femur, femoral stem, Gruen-zone stress shielding, or bone-implant micromotion with contact/friction.
动机· 评估不同种植体宏几何与钻孔方案对初期稳定性的影响。
方法· 在10/20/30 PCF聚氨酯骨块中植入90枚种植体，测量插入扭矩与ISQ。
结果· VEL系统在各密度下稳定性最高，MAE在低密度骨中扭矩低但ISQ足够。
验证· 体外合成骨块实验，每组30枚种植体。
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· Primary stability is essential for osseointegration and is governed by implant macrogeometry and drilling protocol.
Method· Ninety implants of three macrogeometries were placed in synthetic polyurethane blocks of three densities, with insertion torque and implant stability quotient recorded.
Result· The cylindrical-conical system showed the highest stability across densities, whereas the healing-chamber design achieved adequate stability with lower torque in low-density bone.
Validation· In vitro testing on synthetic bone blocks with thirty implants per group.

Tensile Performance and Structural Optimisation of FDM-Printed PLA Components with Different Infill Structures

Medium FEA & Surrogate Modelling openalex Transferable Save for project mechanical_testing Exp. validation
Runqi Liu, Shuo Wang, Keyi Wang, Mingqin Li, Xingwang Liu et al. Symmetry 2026-08-31 10.3390/sym18091461
单位: College of Science and Engineering, Hebei Agricultural University, Cangzhou 061100, China
通讯: Xingwang Liu @ College of Science and Engineering, Hebei Agricultural University, Cangzhou 061100, China  |  Kashan Khan @ Department of Engineering, School of Science & Technology, City St George’s, University of London, London EC1V 0HB, UK
相关性: 该文用Kriging代理模型结合NSGA-II对FDM打印PLA填充结构做多目标优化，方法可迁移到植入体/生物力学设计的代理建模与约束优化。
边界: It addresses FDM-printed PLA tensile specimens for aerospace/automotive lightweighting, with no implant mechanics, no bone-implant interface, no biomedical validation, and no uncertainty quantification.
动机· FDM打印PLA的力学性能受内部填充结构影响，需在减重与强度间权衡。
方法· 对三种填充拓扑与三种密度做拉伸试验，并用ABAQUS非线性有限元建模，再用Kriging代理模型结合NSGA-II优化。
结果· 蜂窝结构强度最高，优化后密度0.378时减重62.2%仍保留约80%强度，并给出四类设计准则。
验证· 单轴拉伸实验与有限元结果对比，峰值载荷最大误差1.39%。
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· The mechanical response of FDM-printed PLA is strongly governed by its internal infill architecture, motivating a trade-off between mass reduction and strength.
Method· Tensile specimens with honeycomb, grid, and triangular infills at three density levels were tested and simulated with nonlinear ABAQUS models, then optimized via a Kriging surrogate coupled with NSGA-II.
Result· Honeycomb infill exhibited the highest strength, and the optimized design at 0.378 density reduced material use by 62.2% while retaining about 80% of solid tensile strength, yielding four design guidelines.
Validation· Uniaxial tensile experiments were compared against finite element predictions, with peak-load errors below 1.39%.

相关性: 该文系统研究了LPBF工艺参数对AZ91镁合金致密化、微观组织、力学性能及Hanks溶液中腐蚀行为的影响，属于AM生物医用材料方向，但未涉及多孔结构设计、应力遮挡或骨整合验证。

Motivation· To determine how LPBF processing parameters govern the densification, microstructure, mechanical properties, and corrosion behaviour of AZ91 magnesium alloy.
Method· Twenty-four laser power and scanning speed combinations were screened, and two representative conditions were compared with an as-cast reference via microstructural, tensile, and electrochemical characterisation.
Result· The optimised condition achieved 99.75% densification and 279 MPa ultimate tensile strength with more stable degradation kinetics, whereas the as-cast alloy exhibited the highest overall corrosion resistance.
Validation· Experimental validation included density measurements, microstructural analysis, tensile testing, and corrosion testing in Hanks' solution.

相关性: 该文用静磁场调控LPBF锌镁合金的层级微观结构以提升强塑性，属于AM生物医用材料方向，但未涉及多孔结构、应力遮挡或疲劳性能。
边界: It does not link porous architecture to stiffness matching or stress shielding, reports no fatigue or osseointegration testing, and provides only static tensile characterization of a bulk Zn-Mg alloy.
动机· LPBF锌镁合金中粗大脆性共晶相易引发应力集中和早期断裂。

Motivation· Coarse brittle eutectic phases in LPBF-fabricated Zn-Mg alloys cause premature stress concentration and fracture, limiting their use for bone repair.
Method· A vertical static magnetic field of 0.14-0.18 T was applied during LPBF to tailor the hierarchical eutectic, grain, and pore architecture of a Zn-Mg alloy.
Result· The SMF-assisted alloy achieved roughly 3.34% elongation and 255.13 MPa ultimate tensile strength, corresponding to 7.78-fold and 0.12-fold improvements over the unassisted counterpart.
Validation· Mechanical tensile testing combined with microstructural characterization confirmed the strength-ductility synergy arising from grain boundary and precipitation strengthening.

Motivation· To quantify wall shear stress distributions in patient-specific coronary arteries and bypass grafts under different blood rheology assumptions.

Lahbib Zentari, Guillermo Chillcce, Jakob Rzeszutko, Ould el Moctar Ocean Engineering 2026-09-08 10.1016/j.oceaneng.2026.127668
单位: Federal Waterways Engineering and Research Institute, Kußmaulstr. 17, 76187 Karlsruhe, Germany
通讯: Lahbib Zentari @ Federal Waterways Engineering and Research Institute, Kußmaulstr. 17, 76187 Karlsruhe, Germany
相关性: 该论文将高斯过程代理模型与贝叶斯优化结合以减少昂贵CFD采样，方法可迁移到植入物/生物力学FEA的代理建模与设计优化。
边界: It addresses ship hydrodynamics CFD sampling rather than implant biomechanics, and provides no FEA validation, no bone-implant interface mechanics, and no uncertainty quantification of the surrogate itself.
动机· 内河船舶转弯漂角的准确预测对航道安全设计至关重要，但实验与自由航行CFD成本过高。
方法· 用URANS高保真仿真结合高斯过程代理的贝叶斯优化，自适应选点以最小化运动方程损失。
结果· 少于60次URANS评估即恢复准稳态漂角，偏差低于1%，12小时完成。
验证· 与中等浅水自由航行回转模型试验对比验证。
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· Accurate prediction of the drift angle of inland waterway ships during turning is essential for safe fairway design, yet experimental campaigns and free-running CFD are prohibitively expensive.
Method· A surrogate-assisted framework couples high-fidelity URANS simulations with Bayesian optimization over a Gaussian process surrogate, adaptively selecting design points to minimize a loss derived from the equations of motion.
Result· The framework recovers the quasi-steady drift angle within experimental uncertainty using fewer than 60 URANS evaluations, with a deviation below 1% and 12 hours of wall-clock time on 384 CPU cores.
Validation· Predictions were validated against free-running turning circle model tests in moderately shallow water at a depth-to-draft ratio of 2.75.

相关性: 该论文在LPBF Ti-6Al-4V中嵌入应变传感结构并做力学与细胞相容性验证，与增材制造生物医学植入物方向相关，但未涉及多孔结构、应力遮挡或疲劳性能。
边界: It does not study porous lattice design, stiffness matching, stress shielding, fatigue behavior, or osseointegration of biomedical implants; the focus is embedded strain sensing rather than implant mechanics.
动机· 高温金属增材制造中难以嵌入热敏感传感结构，需实现金属内部状态自监测。
方法· 结合聚合物-金属应变计高分辨打印与粉末介导热保护，在LPBF Ti-6Al-4V中嵌入多层应变传感架构。

Motivation· Wood non-destructive testing suffers from significant uncertainty when measurement points are incomplete, motivating a principled quantification and sensor-placement strategy.
Method· A Bayesian uncertainty model based on hyper-robust estimation is formulated, together with chord-mean and diameter-mean information gain strategies for selecting new measurement points.
Result· The proposed approach achieves 86.86% agreement with measurements, with the diameter-mean strategy outperforming the chord-mean one and 45°/135° paths improving information gain.
Validation· Validation combines laboratory material and component tests, on-site inspection of historic buildings, stochastic finite element analysis with Latin Hypercube sampling, and vibration testing.

动机· 氚增殖比常被当作确定值报告，缺少可信的核数据误差范围。
方法· 将TBR写成输运问题的积分响应泛函，用广义微扰理论求截面灵敏度并按三明治法则传播通道分辨的不确定度。
结果· 两个轻核通道贡献约95%的模型形式方差，跨库复现仅差0.3%，说明误差来自评价数据而非计算路径。

英文摘要与术语
Motivation· Tritium breeding ratio predictions are frequently quoted as single values without a defensible uncertainty band.
Method· The TBR is expressed as an integral response functional of the transport problem, first-order cross-section sensitivities are derived via generalized perturbation theory, and channel-resolved data uncertainties are propagated through the sandwich rule.
Result· Two light breeding channels account for roughly 95% of the model-form variance, while cross-library reproduction agrees to 0.3%, indicating the evaluated data rather than the code path dominates the error budget.
Validation· Numerical comparison using OpenMC/MCNP three-dimensional Monte Carlo transport with ENDF/B-VIII.0, TALYS, and FENDL-3.2 evaluated data.

边界: No FEA surrogate, no neural operator/PINN, no biomedical or implant mechanics context; it is a fusion plasma design UQ study using reduced-order 0-D balance models.
动机· 聚变装置设计点通常只报告单一性能数值，缺乏对联合参数不确定性的全局评估。
方法· 对两种聚变装置各抽取4万样本，通过降阶功率与粒子平衡模型进行直接蒙特卡洛传播与Sobol方差分解。
结果· 两个设计锚点均位于可行域内部，增殖堆受约束限制、燃烧堆受芯部压强限制，各有一个主导敏感参数。

英文摘要与术语
Motivation· Frozen fusion design points are typically reported as single figures of merit, leaving their robustness under joint parameter uncertainty unquantified.
Method· Two independent 40,000-sample Monte-Carlo ensembles are propagated through reduced-order power- and particle-balance evaluators, with variance-based Sobol/ANOVA sensitivity decomposition using Saltelli/Jansen estimators.
Result· Both design anchors lie well inside their achievable ensembles, and each machine reduces to a single dominant sensitivity lever, indicating robust rather than fragile optima.
Validation· GPU-accelerated Monte-Carlo simulation with explicit prior probability measures and Monte-Carlo error analysis; no experimental or clinical validation.

相关性: 该文用FEA分析牙种植体周围骨缺损的应力分布，与髋关节植入物应力遮挡和LPBF制造无直接关联，仅提供骨-植入物界面力学背景。
边界: This paper addresses dental implant FEA with no LPBF fabrication, no porous structure design, no fatigue testing, and no hip implant stress shielding context.
动机· 前牙区种植体受颊腭侧骨量限制，腭侧皮质骨厚度对生物力学的影响尚不明确。
方法· 建立Dyna种植体三维有限元模型，模拟五种颊腭侧骨缺损构型并计算应力与微应变。
结果· 腭侧骨缺损使种植体峰值应力达599 MPa，骨微应变显著升高，颊侧缺损影响较小。

英文摘要与术语
Motivation· The biomechanical role of palatal cortical wall thickness around anterior maxillary implants remains poorly understood despite known buccal bone remodeling.
Method· A three-dimensional finite element model of a dental implant in a D3 anterior maxilla was constructed to simulate five buccal-palatal cortical bone configurations.
Result· Palatal dehiscence produced the highest implant stress (599 MPa) and elevated cortical and trabecular microstrain, whereas buccal defects yielded more favorable stress patterns.
Validation· Validation relied on finite element simulation using von Mises stress and Wolff's law-based microstrain analysis.

Motivation· Pointwise residual stress inversion is ill-posed and introduces unquantifiable bias that undermines reliability.
Method· The authors reformulate the measurement target as a spatial average over a characteristic length and analyze classical inversion biases.

Validation· A numerical simulation of hole-drilling residual stress measurement on a shot-peened steel component is performed.

英文摘要与术语
Motivation· Early periprosthetic femoral fractures and stem subsidence remain clinically important complications after cementless total hip arthroplasty, particularly for collared hydroxyapatite-coated stems via the direct anterior approach.
Method· A retrospective review of 4,094 primary cementless THAs stratified early periprosthetic fractures by trauma mechanism and assessed radiographic stem subsidence of at least 2 mm.
Result· Periprosthetic fractures occurred in 0.39% of hips and subsidence in 0.15%; non-traumatic fractures and most subsidence cases were managed non-operatively, whereas traumatic fractures frequently required surgery.
Validation· Single-center retrospective clinical case series with radiographic follow-up and no biomechanical or computational validation.

边界: This paper addresses singularly perturbed fractal anomalous diffusion PDEs with no FEA benchmark, no biomedical or implant mechanics context, and no surrogate-based design optimization or uncertainty quantification.

英文摘要与术语
Motivation· Singularly perturbed convection-dominated anomalous diffusion problems exhibit sharp boundary layers that degrade the effectiveness of conventional numerical schemes.
Method· A semi-analytical physics-informed neural network framework is developed, in which neural-network corrector functions derived from auxiliary conditions capture thin boundary layers, complemented by Hessian-based convergence and sensitivity analysis.
Result· The approach resolves boundary-layer singularities and delivers accurate solutions for both linear and nonlinear stationary anomalous diffusion equations.
Validation· Numerical examples on standard benchmark problems demonstrate the accuracy and robustness of the proposed framework.

Mishraim Sanchez Torres, Ismael Hernández-Capuchin, José Luis Javier Sánchez-González, Cristina Ramírez-Fernández, Eddie Clemente et al. Measurement Science and Technology 2026-08-26 10.1088/1361-6501/ae9ee5
单位: Tecnologico Nacional de Mexico
相关性: 该论文展示了物理信息神经网络在热弹性变形预测中的校准与验证方法，其框架可迁移至生物力学有限元代理模型的构建与验证。
边界: This paper does not address implant or biomechanics applications, lacks contact mechanics and patient-specific geometry, and does not involve uncertainty quantification in the context of implant design.
动机· 为物理信息代理模型提供可复现的校准与独立验证基准。
方法· 结合Kirchhoff-Love板理论生成合成数据，用FPP标定边界条件，训练PINN并嵌入物理量。
结果· PINN在内部测试集R²=0.9996，外部验证误差低于FEM。
验证· 采用FPP测量三个热状态下的位移场进行外部验证。
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To establish a reproducible metrological benchmark for calibrating and validating physics-informed surrogate models of thermoelastic deformation.
Method· A three-stage framework integrates Kirchhoff-Love plate theory for synthetic data generation, FPP-based calibration of boundary condition factor, and training of a residual PINN with physics-informed inputs and curriculum learning.
Result· The PINN achieves high accuracy on internal tests and outperforms FEM on external FPP validation at lower thermal states, with residual errors at the highest state attributed to plate theory linearization.
Validation· External validation was performed using fringe projection profilometry displacement maps at three thermal states, with measurement uncertainty characterized.
